question: Can even immense material wealth compare to the value of this Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels represents immense wealth
Such wealth may be accumulated by someone
The comparison implies a higher value beyond material riches
inference: Even the wealth of an ocean filled with jewels is not comparable to this teaching
uncertainties: The form akretuṃ is obscure and may be a textual corruption
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
